title: sundamomum durum
intro: Sundamomum durum, commonly known as the sand rose or yellow ginger, is a plant species in the family Zingiberaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Sundamomum durum include its antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
